info.title: Runloop API
info.description: Agent loop 运行时 — 通过 ACP 协议驱动 agent CLI，对外暴露统一的 event-sourced HTTP SSE 接口。资源由上游解析好、直传完整 meta（统一扁平 Resource[]：溯源 resourceType + 调用方式 protocol[mcp→mcpConfig / 其余→openapiConfig] + 鉴权 auth）。

post.description: Accepts events and resources, drives an agent CLI, returns SSE event stream. Response headers `X-Conversation-Id` and `X-Run-Id` contain identifiers for the conversation and this specific run.

X-Conversation-Id.description: Conversation identifier (stable across multiple runs in the same conversation)

X-Run-Id.description: Run identifier (unique per /v1/run invocation, used for tracing/logging)

schema.description: Newline-delimited SSE events. Each event has `event:`, `data:` (JSON), and `id:` fields.

409.description: Conflict — another run is already active for this conversationId

post.description: Spawns registered agent CLIs once to load binaries into OS page cache, then kills them. Subsequent /v1/run requests on the same container will start significantly faster (cold start ~10s → warm ~0.5s). No request body required.

conversationId.description: Conversation ID — stable across multiple runs in the same conversation. Decides the workspace directory. Auto-generated if omitted.

runId.description: Run ID — unique identifier for this specific /v1/run invocation. Auto-generated if omitted. Used for tracing and logging.

events.description: Full event history. New user message + all previous events for replay.

resources.description: Unified flat platform resource list. Each item = 溯源(resourceId/resourceName/resourceType) + 调用方式(protocol + mcpConfig|openapiConfig) + 鉴权(auth). See Resource schema.

clientTools.description: Client-declared, client-executed tools (= chat-completions tools / ag-ui frontend tools). Calling one pauses the run (tool_pending) until the client feeds back a toolresult on the next run.

credentials.description: 平台凭证（AK/SK，可带 STS securityToken）。条件必填：仅当存在 auth.mode=agentrun 资源、或有 SKILL/SANDBOX 资源（agentrun 数据面下载/调用）时必填；全外部工具（auth.mode=none）场景可省略。

headers.description: Extra HTTP headers forwarded to downstream agentrun resource calls (global default; merged with per-resource headers, resource-level wins). Runloop's own signing/required headers always win.

AgentConfig.description: Agent CLI runtime configuration — how to launch the agent CLI, where, with what environment / prompt / limits.

cwd.description: Working directory override (defaults to the conversation workspace).

env.description: Environment variables injected into the agent CLI process. Runloop's required vars (OPENAI_API_KEY=proxy token, CODEX_HOME, NO_PROXY, dropped-privilege HOME/USER) always win; still filtered by the dropped-privilege env allowlist (cannot smuggle secrets into the non-root codex).

systemPrompt.description: User-provided instructions appended after the built-in Super Agent system prompt.

HitlConfig.description: Human-in-the-Loop approval configuration (switch + static rules). AD-026.

rules.description: Static rules: a tool call whose name matches a rule with action 'ask' is force-suspended for approval.

HitlClientCapabilities.description: Client HITL capability declaration (AD-026 F1/F3). runloop uses it to (F1) only let the model trigger the listed interaction kinds, and to pick the surface per suspend: native event / map to client tool / NL. Safety main-track confirm + NL floor are not gated by F1.

interactions.description: F1: interaction kinds the client supports and the model is allowed to trigger. Kinds not listed are not exposed to the model (except safety main-track confirm and the NL floor).

nativeHitl.description: Client can consume native toolcall.suspend events directly; when true, listed interaction kinds are delivered as native events.

renderTools.description: Optional explicit interaction-kind -> client tool name map for deterministic rendering, e.g. {"choice":"super_agent_choices"}. When an interaction has no explicit mapping and nativeHitl is false, runloop maps it to a suitable client tool (or NL) via a dedicated pure-HITL LLM call (F3).

parameters.description: JSON Schema for the tool inputs.

InputEvent.description: Input event. Open object — all extra fields (toolCallId, result, parentToolCallId, command, args, selectedOptionId, reason, options, role, ...) are preserved for event-sourced replay / HITL resume / nested delegation.

type.description: Event type. Use 'user.message' for new user input.

example.content: Hello, help me refactor this code

baseUrl.description: Required at runtime — agent CLI must not call upstream LLM directly

apiKey.description: Required at runtime — used by ModelProviderProxy

ResourceTypeEnum.description: agentrun 资源类型（溯源用，= 平台资源概念，回溯/引用）；同时是 runloop 业务特殊处理的开关——AGENT 委派 / SKILL 下载 / SANDBOX(实例)·SANDBOX_TEMPLATE(模板) 生命周期，其余为普通工具调用。不再是调用方式判别符（调用方式见 protocol）。

ProtocolEnum.description: 调用方式——runloop 与该资源通信的协议。mcp→用 mcpConfig；openapi/ag-ui/chat-completions/runloop/a2a→用 openapiConfig（标准 OpenAPI 文档）。其中 ag-ui/chat-completions/runloop/a2a 为子 agent 委派协议（配合 resourceType=AGENT）。a2a=Agent2Agent 协议（JSON-RPC 2.0 over HTTP+SSE，message/stream 流式委派、Task/Message/status-update/artifact-update 事件）。

McpConfig.description: 纯标准 MCP server 连接配置（protocol=mcp 时用）——可直接喂标准 MCP client，**不含任何 runloop 私有字段**。stdio 用 command/args/env；http·sse 用 url/headers。静态工具清单是 runloop 扩展、不属 MCP 标准，见 Resource.toolManifest。

ResourceAuth.description: 调用鉴权方式。none(默认)=只透传 headers、runloop 不签；agentrun=runloop 用 credentials 按 AGENTRUN4-HMAC-SHA256 / Agentrun-Authorization 自动签名（agentrun 数据面）。

Resource.description: 统一资源（扁平）。三轴：① 溯源 resourceId/resourceName/resourceType（agentrun 概念 + 业务处理开关）；② 调用方式 protocol（mcp→mcpConfig / 其余→openapiConfig）；③ 鉴权 auth。约束（运行时校验）：protocol=mcp ⇒ 须带 mcpConfig，否则 ⇒ 须带 openapiConfig。

resourceId.description: = agentrun 资源 id（稳定唯一，immutable；溯源/引用/幂等）。resourceType=SANDBOX 时为运行中实例 id（直接用）；=SANDBOX_TEMPLATE 时为模板 id（runloop 懒创建实例+回收）。

resourceName.description: 逻辑名——用于生成暴露给模型的工具名、注入提示词。

openapiConfig.description: 标准 OpenAPI 文档（protocol≠mcp 时用，格式同 openapi.json）。每个 operation=一个工具、operationId=工具名（必须存在且唯一）；inputSchema 从 operation 的 parameters/requestBody 派生。runloop 据 resourceType 特殊处理：AGENT/SKILL 单 operation 直接用、多 operation 须含保留 operationId（AGENT=invoke、SKILL=download）；SANDBOX/SANDBOX_TEMPLATE 多 operation=多工具、全部共享（懒创建出的）实例 serverUrl。

headers.description: 资源级附加 header —— openapi/委派下游 HTTP 调用的**调用时供给通道**。典型是外部鉴权密钥（Bearer/apikey）：OpenAPI 的 securitySchemes 只声明鉴权方案、**密钥值故意留给调用方在此供给**（不写进 openapiConfig 文档），这正是本字段存在的理由、非 openapiConfig 的冗余。非密常量 header（如固定 X-Tenant）也可改写进 openapiConfig 的 const 参数。与顶层 headers 合并、资源级优先、runloop 签名/必备 header 最高优先；MCP 连接自身 header 用 mcpConfig.headers。

toolManifest.description: 静态工具清单（可选，**runloop 扩展、非 MCP 标准**，故置于标准 mcpConfig 之外）。仅 protocol=mcp 用——codex 只连 runloop 单个进程内 agentrun-mcp 聚合器，下游 MCP server 都被它聚合/代理；MCP 工具发现本是运行时 round-trip（连下游→initialize→tools/list），慢下游拖慢 agent 首 token。声明此清单后聚合器**立刻把工具呈现给 agent**（首 token 不等下游启动），首次实际调用才**懒连**下游转发、并用真实 tools/list **校正**（self-heal）。缺省则聚合器启动时连下游 tools/list 发现（首 token 等下游）。protocol≠mcp 不用此字段——openapiConfig 的 operations 已自描述工具。

inputSchema.description: JSON Schema（暴露给模型的入参）。

serverManagesHistory.description: 子 agent（protocol=ag-ui/a2a/runloop 等委派目标）是否**服务端自管会话/历史**。`true`=该 agent 按 threadId 在服务端保存自己的会话（含挂起的 HITL）——runloop 多次委派/HITL resume 传**一致的 threadId**、只下发**增量** messages（最新一轮 + 审批决策）。`false`/缺省=无服务端会话（无状态 agent）——runloop 每次下发**完整** messages（原始任务 + 子轨迹 + 审批决策）+ resume 标识，让其自行重建。仅影响委派类资源（AGENT）。来源：平台 protocolSettings[ag-ui].config.serverManagesHistory（前端可标）。

Features.description: 灰度/实验/内部控制开关（如 toolBridge）。业务配置（hitl/agent/model/resources 等）不进 features。

toolBridge.description: 内部控制开关：runloop 把非 mcp 资源（openapi 工具 / 委派 / 沙箱）经进程内 agentrun-mcp 聚合器暴露给 agent CLI 的桥接方式。`mcp`=codex 原生 MCP 调用（默认）；`cli`=`.tools/agentrun` shell 隧道（降级，特定场景保效果用）。缺省 `mcp`。

execViaMcp.description: 命令执行（shell）的归属：`true`（**默认**）=关掉 agent CLI 内建 shell，执行改走 runloop 自有的 `shell` MCP 工具（统一过 HITL 主轨闸门、可审计、后端可换远端隔离沙箱）；`false`=用 agent CLI 内建 shell（如 codex 的 exec_command，自带流式 / write_stdin）。缺省 `true`（走我们的 MCP）。运维可用 env `AGENTCORE_EXEC_VIA_MCP=0` 作为全局 kill-switch（仅当请求未显式指定时生效）。

parentToolCallId.description: Nested delegation parent. Follow the chain to reconstruct the call tree.

RunloopEvent.description: Output event. See spec/events.json for all 24 event types.

elapsedMs.description: Time taken to pre-warm in milliseconds
